name: Sharmok 718
description: A Hapan vessel, Sharmok 718 was a transport utilized by the New Jedi Order during the evacuation from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus. In opposition, the Lost Tribe of Sith's armada deployed a wing of antiquated Skipray twelve-jays to ambush the Jedi academy, while the Jedi evacuation effort was covered by four wings of Hapan Miy'til starfighters.
